1160034: This soap is part of the Wild Botanicals lineup. Their products are vegan and handmade from 100% all natural ingredients that are, when possible, organic or wildcrafted from sustainable sources, no preservatives or artificial ingredients. The label is handmade seeded lokta paper from Nepal. You can plant the paper and the seeds will sprout into wildflowers. Almond Honey Oatmeal Soap is scented with almond essential oil and and infused with honey and oatmeal. It is wrapped in Wildflower Seed Paper and packaged in a reusable muslin bag. INGREDIENTS: organic sunflower oil, organic coconut oil, organic olive oil, castor oil, organic sustainable palm oil, water, sodium hydroxide, organic shea butter, essential oil, organic oatmeal flour, local honey
